observations.detail: Tests use a custom lightweight harness (test/assert helpers with tsx runner) defined inline in each test file. All 18 tests pass. Follow this pattern for new test files — do not introduce Jest/Vitest.

Rate-limit middleware lives at src/middleware/rate-limit.ts. It exports the rateLimit factory, MemoryStore class, and TypeScript interfaces (RateLimitOptions, RateLimitRequest, RateLimitResponse, RateLimitStore) for extensibility.
ESM imports require .js extensions even for TypeScript source files (e.g., import from '../middleware/rate-limit.js'). This is enforced by the type: module setting in package.json.

Sliding window algorithm chosen over fixed-window counter. Stores an array of timestamps per key, pruned on each request. Trade-off: O(n) memory per key where n = maxRequests, but prevents burst allowance at window boundaries.

Full rate-limiting documentation added to docs/guides/rate-limiting.md covering quick start, config options table, 429 response format, custom keyGenerator, custom store (Redis example), and sliding window explanation.
No git remote is configured on this repo. Branches are local only. PRs cannot be pushed to a remote — must add a remote origin before PR workflow is possible.
The package.json test script was updated from a placeholder echo to 'npx tsx src/__tests__/rate-limit.test.ts'. If additional test files are added, the script will need to be updated to run them all.
